source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 20 (PDF 59-74), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 20 (Aromatic Hydrocarbons) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are arenes? Why were benzene compounds first called 'aromatic'?
(Arenes kya hain? Benzene compounds ko pehle 'aromatic' kyun kaha gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Arenes woh hydrocarbons hain jin mein aik ya ziyada benzene rings hon. 19vi sadi ke shuru mein benzene se bane compounds khushbu-daar paaye gaye (maslan vanilla), is liye unhein 'aromatic' (meethi khushbu wale) kaha gaya.

book_ref.quote: Organic hydrocarbons containing one or more benzene rings are known as arenes.

blocks.prompt:
2 Is it correct that all aromatic compounds smell good? Justify with the chapter's example.
(Kya yeh sahih hai ke tamaam aromatic compounds ki khushbu achhi hoti hai? Chapter ki misaal se wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Aaj 'aromatic' ka matlab benzene ya benzene jaisi ring wale molecules hain, aur in mein se kuch ki boo buri hoti hai. Camphor (camphor laurel ke darakht se) ki tez minty khushbu hai magar is mein benzene ring nahi, is liye yeh non-aromatic hai.

book_ref.quote: However, the term 'aromatic' continues to be used today

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe Kekule's structure of benzene. Why were the earlier linear structures rejected?
(Benzene ka Kekule structure bayan karein. Pehle ke linear structures kyun radd hue?)
blocks.explanation: 1865 mein August Kekule ne benzene (C₆H₆) ko chhe members wala cyclic compound bataya jis mein single aur double bonds baari baari hain. Pehle ke linear structures benzene ki properties samjha nahi sake, is liye radd hue.

book_ref.quote: six membered cyclic compound having alternate single and double bonds

blocks.prompt:
4 Give the main shortcoming of Kekule's structure, using the bond length found by X-ray studies.
(X-ray se mili bond length ki madad se Kekule structure ki bunyaadi kami batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Kekule ke baari baari single aur double bonds se do C–C lengths (154 pm aur 133 pm) hoti. X-ray batata hai ke chhe C–C bonds barabar (139 pm) hain, is liye yeh structure benzene ki properties poori tarah nahi samjhata.

book_ref.quote: it didn’t fully explain the physical and chemical properties of benzene

blocks.prompt:
5 State the shape, bond angles and bond lengths of benzene found by X-ray studies.
(X-ray studies se benzene ki shakal, bond angles aur bond lengths batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Benzene planar hai, chhe sp² carbons ka regular hexagon. C–C–C aur H–C–C angles 120° hain. C–C bond length = 139 pm (1.3970 Å) aur C–H = 109 pm (1.090 Å).

book_ref.quote: planar configuration characterized by a regular hexagon

blocks.prompt:
6 The C–C bond length of benzene is 1.3970 Å. Express it in pm and find how much shorter it is than a C–C single bond (154 pm).
(Benzene ki C–C bond length 1.3970 Å hai. Isay pm mein likhein aur batayein ke yeh C–C single bond (154 pm) se kitni chhoti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
1 Å = 100 pm, to 1.3970 Å = 139.7 pm.
Farq = 154 − 139.7 = 14.3 pm, single bond se chhoti (magar C=C, 133 pm, se lambi).

book_ref.quote: falling between the single bond lengths of sp³ hybridized carbons (154 pm)

blocks.text: 20.1.1 Thermodynamic Stability of Benzene and Resonance

blocks.prompt:
7 How do heats of hydrogenation show that benzene is more stable than the hypothetical cyclohexatriene?
(Heats of hydrogenation kaise batati hain ke benzene farzi cyclohexatriene se ziyada stable hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cyclohexene 120 kJ mol⁻¹ deta hai, to cyclohexatriene (teen C=C) ko 3 × 120 = 360 kJ mol⁻¹ dena chahiye. Benzene asal mein sirf 208 kJ mol⁻¹ deta hai. 152 kJ mol⁻¹ kam energy ki wajah se benzene bohat ziyada stable hai.

book_ref.quote: Evidence of the increased stability of benzene is obtained by measuring the heat emitted

blocks.prompt:
8 Define resonance energy. What is its value for benzene?
(Resonance energy ki definition likhein. Benzene ke liye is ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Resonance energy (delocalisation energy) woh miqdaar hai jitni benzene ki asal heat of hydrogenation theoretical qeemat se kam hai. Benzene ke liye 360 − 208 = 152 kJ mol⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: This energy is called the resonance energy (delocalisation energy) of benzene.

blocks.prompt:
9 A cyclic alkene with one C=C gives 116 kJ mol⁻¹ on hydrogenation. An aromatic ring with three such bonds gives 200 kJ mol⁻¹. Calculate its resonance energy.
(Aik C=C wali cyclic alkene hydrogenation par 116 kJ mol⁻¹ deti hai. Teen aise bonds wala aromatic ring 200 kJ mol⁻¹ deta hai. Resonance energy nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tawaqqo = 3 × 116 = 348 kJ mol⁻¹.
Resonance energy = 348 − 200 = 148 kJ mol⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: These heats of hydrogenation can be related to the relative thermodynamic stability of the compounds.

blocks.prompt:
10 Why is cyclohexane used as the reference point in the energy diagram of hydrogenation?
(Hydrogenation ke energy diagram mein cyclohexane ko reference point kyun liya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cyclohexene, cyclohexadiene aur benzene sab hydrogenation par cyclohexane dete hain. Is liye cyclohexane mushtarka low-energy reference point hai jis se in ki heats aur stability ka muqabla hota hai.

book_ref.quote: cyclohexane symbolizes a low-energy reference point

blocks.prompt:
11 Why is benzene much more stable than expected from its three double bonds?
(Benzene apne teen double bonds ke hisaab se tawaqqo se ziyada stable kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ke π electrons teen double bonds mein qaid nahi; chhe carbons par π orbital overlap se poori ring par phaile (delocalised) hain. Is se energy 152 kJ mol⁻¹ kam ho jati hai (resonance energy).

book_ref.quote: delocalised over the ring through the π orbital overlap on all the six carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
12 What heat of hydrogenation would benzene have if it really had three isolated C=C bonds? How does the actual value compare?
(Agar benzene mein waqai teen alag C=C bonds hote to is ki heat of hydrogenation kitni hoti? Asal qeemat se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh farzi cyclohexatriene ke barabar hoti: 3 × 120 = 360 kJ mol⁻¹. Asal qeemat sirf 208 kJ mol⁻¹ hai, yani 152 kJ mol⁻¹ kam, is liye benzene saada cyclohexatriene nahi.

book_ref.quote: Following this, we must expect that heat of hydrogenation of benzene would be much higher if it were a cyclohexene too.

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain the σ framework of benzene.
(Benzene ka σ framework samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Har carbon sp² hai. Us ke teen sp² orbitals teen σ bonds banate hain: do saath wale carbons se aur aik hydrogen se (sp²–s). Tamaam sp² orbitals aik plane mein hain, is liye tamaam C aur H atoms 120° par aik plane mein hain.

book_ref.quote: The three sp² hybrid orbitals on each carbon are utilized to form three σ-bonds

blocks.prompt:
14 How is the π-electron cloud of benzene formed?
(Benzene ka π-electron cloud kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har carbon ka aik unhybridized 2p orbital σ framework par amood hai. Chhe parallel 2p orbitals sideways overlap kar ke ring ke upar aur neeche π-electron cloud banate hain; molecule conjugated ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: form a π-electron cloud above and below the plane of the benzene ring

blocks.prompt:
15 Why is benzene represented as a hexagon with a circle inside it?
(Benzene ko hexagon ke andar circle se kyun dikhaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hexagon chhe carbons ki ring hai. Circle chhe delocalized π electrons dikhata hai jo chhe carbons mein barabar share hain; isi liye tamaam C–C bonds barabar (139 pm) hain aur fixed double bonds nahi banaye jate.

book_ref.quote: represented as a hexagon with a circle inscribed

blocks.prompt:
16 Compare the C–C bond length of benzene with the values in Table 20.1. What does it show?
(Benzene ki C–C bond length ka Table 20.1 ki qeematon se muqabla karein. Is se kya pata chalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 20.1: C–C 154 pm, C=C 133 pm, C≡C 120 pm. Benzene ke tamaam C–C bonds 139 pm hain, single aur double ke darmiyan. Yani bonds na single hain na double; π electrons delocalized hain.

book_ref.quote: This delocalization causes all the six C - C bond lengths to be same (139 pm).

blocks.prompt:
17 Which orbitals overlap to form the C–C and C–H σ bonds of benzene?
(Benzene ke C–C aur C–H σ bonds kin orbitals ke overlap se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: C–C σ bond: aik carbon ka sp² aur saath wale carbon ka sp² (sp²–sp²). C–H σ bond: carbon ka sp² aur hydrogen ka 1s orbital (sp²–s).

book_ref.quote: hydrogen bonds with its 1s orbital, so the bond is sp2-s

blocks.prompt:
18 How many σ bonds, π electrons and sp² carbon atoms are there in one benzene molecule?
(Aik benzene molecule mein kitne σ bonds, π electrons aur sp² carbons hain?)
blocks.explanation: σ bonds: 6 C–C + 6 C–H = 12. π electrons: 6 (har 2p orbital se aik), delocalized. sp² carbons: tamaam 6.

book_ref.quote: The three sp² hybrid orbitals on each carbon are utilized

blocks.prompt:
19 Why is benzene called a conjugated molecule?
(Benzene ko conjugated molecule kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har carbon ka aik, chhe parallel 2p orbitals poori ring mein sideways overlap karte hain aur plane ke upar neeche aik musalsal π-electron cloud banta hai. Chhe π electrons chhe carbons mein share hain, is liye molecule conjugated hai.

book_ref.quote: making it a conjugated molecule

blocks.prompt:
20 Differentiate between monocyclic and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons.
(Monocyclic aur polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: In ka farq molecule mein benzene rings ki tadaad ka hai.

book_ref.quote: two or more benzene rings in their molecules are known as polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons

rows: Maslan jude hue benzene rings wale compounds
Substituted benzene ya khaas naam se naam

blocks.prompt:
21 How are monosubstituted benzenes named? Give two examples of each style.
(Monosubstituted benzenes ke naam kaise rakhe jate hain? Har tareeqe ki do misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: 'Benzene' base aur substituent prefix ke saath: chlorobenzene, nitrobenzene. IUPAC mein qabool aam/khaas naamon se: phenol (C₆H₅OH), toluene (C₆H₅CH₃), aniline. Number ki zaroorat nahi kyun ke substituent hamesha C-1 par hai.

book_ref.quote: The substituent in a monosubstituted benzene is always at C-1, so there is no need to number its location.

blocks.prompt:
22 State the rules for numbering a disubstituted benzene.
(Disubstituted benzene ki numbering ke qawaid likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ziyada priority wale substituent ka carbon C₁ hai, baaqi us ke hisaab se. Priority: –COOH > –CN > –CHO > –COCH₃ > –OH > –NH₂ > –OR > –R. Barabar priority ho to alphabet mein pehle wala C₁ leta hai.

book_ref.quote: The carbon to which a higher priority substituent is attached is C₁.

blocks.prompt:
23 Name a benzene ring carrying a chlorine atom and an iodine atom at para positions. Give a reason.
(Benzene ring jis par chlorine aur iodine para positions par hon, us ka naam likhein. Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: 1-chloro-4-iodobenzene. Dono halogens ki priority barabar hai, is liye chloro (alphabet mein pehle) C₁ leta hai; para yani 1 aur 4.

book_ref.quote: If both substituents are the same priority then the carbon having a substituent lower in alphabets is designated as C₁.

blocks.prompt:
24 Name the compounds: (i) a benzene ring with –CHO and –OH at 1,4 positions (base name with –CHO at C₁ as benzaldehyde); (ii) a benzene ring with –CN and –CH₃ meta to each other (base name benzonitrile for –CN at C₁).
(Compounds ke naam likhein: (i) benzene ring par –CHO aur –OH 1,4 par (–CHO wale C₁ ka base name benzaldehyde); (ii) –CN aur –CH₃ aik doosre se meta par (–CN wale C₁ ka base name benzonitrile).)
blocks.explanation: (i) –CHO ki priority –OH se ziyada, woh C₁ hai: 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde. (ii) –CN ki priority –R se ziyada, woh C₁ aur CH₃ C₃ par: 3-methylbenzonitrile.

book_ref.quote: The order of priority of substituents (left to right) is

blocks.prompt:
25 What are ortho, meta and para positions? Give the locants of each.
(Ortho, meta aur para positions kya hain? Har aik ke numbers batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Disubstituted benzene mein do substituents ka rishta: ortho (o-) = 1,2 (saath wale carbons), meta (m-) = 1,3, para (p-) = 1,4 (aamne saamne). Maslan 1,4-dibromobenzene = p-dibromobenzene.

book_ref.quote: ortho- (o-), meta- (m-), or para (p-) can be used in place of positional markers

blocks.prompt:
26 What are disubstituted benzenes? Name one with two different halogens at ortho positions.
(Disubstituted benzenes kya hain? Ortho positions par do mukhtalif halogens wale aik compound ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Disubstituted benzenes mein benzene ring par do substituents hote hain. Misaal: saath wale carbons par bromine aur chlorine; priority barabar, bromo (alphabet mein pehle) C₁: 1-bromo-2-chlorobenzene (o-bromochlorobenzene).

book_ref.quote: Disubstituted benzenes are compounds when two substituents are present on the benzene ring.

blocks.text: 20.3 Comparison of Reactivity of Benzene with Alkanes and Alkenes

blocks.prompt:
27 Why are alkanes unreactive while alkenes are very reactive?
(Alkanes reactive kyun nahi jab ke alkenes bohat reactive hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes non-polar hain aur sirf σ bonds rakhte hain, is liye reactive nahi (sirf UV light mein free radical substitution). Alkenes ke π bond ke electrons electrophiles ko milte hain, is liye yeh electrophilic addition aasani se karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Alkanes are generally an unreactive class of organic compounds due to their non-polar nature and the presence of sigma bond only.

blocks.prompt:
28 Benzene has three π bonds, yet it prefers substitution to addition. Give reason.
(Benzene ke teen π bonds hain, phir bhi yeh addition ki jagah substitution kyun karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene π electrons ki wasee delocalisation ki wajah se bohat stable hai. Substitution mein intermediate mein tooti aromaticity aakhir mein wapas aa jati hai. Addition delocalisation ko hamesha ke liye khatam kar deta, is liye pasandeeda nahi.

book_ref.quote: Unlike alkenes, it undergoes the electrophilic substitution and not electrophilic addition reactions

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between the reactions of benzene and cyclohexene with bromine.
(Benzene aur cyclohexene ke bromine ke saath reactions mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Cyclohexene bromine add karta hai; benzene substitution karta hai.

book_ref.quote: but cyclohexene adds bromine readily

rows: Electrophilic substitution: Br aik H ki jagah
Product C₆H₅Br + HBr; aromatic ring qaim
Product dibromide; π bond toot jata hai

blocks.prompt:
30 Give the two key differences between the reactions of benzene and alkenes with electrophiles.
(Electrophiles ke saath benzene aur alkenes ke reactions ke do bunyaadi farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Do farq: stability/reactivity aur reaction ki qisam.

book_ref.quote: benzene is very stable and thus less reactive.

rows: Bohat stable, is liye kam reactive
Maujood π electrons ki wajah se bohat reactive

blocks.prompt:
31 Name the three main steps of electrophilic aromatic substitution.
(Electrophilic aromatic substitution ke teen bunyaadi steps ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Electrophile banana (in situ). (2) Electrophilic hamla: benzene ke π electrons E⁺ par hamla kar ke sigma complex banate hain. (3) Aromaticity ki wapsi: base sp³ carbon se H⁺ nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: the electrophilic aromatic substitution mechanism can be divided into three main steps

blocks.prompt:
32 What is meant by generating an electrophile in situ? Give one example.
(Electrophile ko in situ banane se kya muraad hai? Aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Electrophile aam tor par seedha nahi dala ja sakta; munasib reagents dal kar mixture ke andar banaya jata hai. Maslan NO₂⁺ conc. HNO₃ aur conc. H₂SO₄ ke reaction se mixture mein banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Typically, electrophiles cannot simply be added to the reaction mixture.

blocks.prompt:
33 What is a sigma complex? Why is it not aromatic?
(Sigma complex kya hai? Yeh aromatic kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh woh intermediate hai jo benzene ke π electrons ke electrophile par hamle se banta hai; ring carbon aur E mein naya σ bond. Woh carbon sp³ ho jata hai; sirf chaar π electrons rehte hain aur positive charge paanch carbons par, is liye aromaticity toot jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Because of the new sigma bond formed, this intermediate is called a sigma complex.

blocks.prompt:
34 How is aromaticity restored in the last step of electrophilic substitution?
(Electrophilic substitution ke aakhri step mein aromaticity kaise wapas aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Counterion/conjugate base sp³ carbon ka hydrogen C–H bond ki heterolytic cleavage se nikalta hai. Bond ke electrons benzene ke π system mein wapas jate hain aur delocalisation bahaal ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: This happens by heterolytic cleavage of the C-H bond.

blocks.prompt:
35 Why is a Lewis acid needed for bromination of benzene? Name three Lewis acids used.
(Benzene ki bromination ke liye Lewis acid kyun zaroori hai? Teen Lewis acids ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Benzene bohat stable hai aur akela Br₂ kaafi taqatwar electrophile nahi. Lewis acid halogen se jud kar usay polarise karta hai (Brδ+–Brδ−) aur taqatwar electrophile Br⁺ banata hai. Lewis acids: AlCl₃, FeCl₃, FeBr₃.

book_ref.quote: Benzene only reacts with bromine and chlorine in the presence of Lewis acids

blocks.prompt:
36 Write equations for the formation of Br⁺ from Br₂ and AlBr₃ and for the regeneration of the catalyst.
(Br₂ aur AlBr₃ se Br⁺ banne aur catalyst ki wapsi ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Br₂ + AlBr₃ → Br⁺ + [AlBr₄]⁻
Sigma complex + [AlBr₄]⁻ → C₆H₅Br + HBr + AlBr₃
Kul: C₆H₆ + Br₂ → C₆H₅Br + HBr (AlBr₃ catalyst).

book_ref.quote: In bromination the sigma complex is deprotonated by [AlBr₄]⁻

blocks.prompt:
37 What is nitration of benzene? Name the reagents and the electrophile.
(Benzene ki nitration kya hai? Reagents aur electrophile ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nitration benzene par nitro group (–NO₂) lagana hai. Reagents: conc. HNO₃ aur conc. H₂SO₄ ka mixture. Electrophile: NO₂⁺ ion.
C₆H₆ + HNO₃ → C₆H₅NO₂ + H₂O

book_ref.quote: Nitro group is introduced on benzene, using mixture of conc. HNO₃ and conc. H₂SO₄.

blocks.prompt:
38 Why must the temperature be controlled during nitration of benzene? Which by-product forms?
(Benzene ki nitration mein temperature kyun qaboo mein rakha jata hai? Kaun sa zimni product banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ziyada temperature par aik se ziyada nitro groups lag sakte hain. 50 °C par bhi kuch 1,3-dinitrobenzene banta hai, kyun ke –NO₂ doosre group ko meta par bhejta hai.

book_ref.quote: At higher temperatures there is a greater chance of getting more than one nitro group substituted onto the ring.

blocks.prompt:
39 Differentiate between Friedel-Crafts alkylation and acylation.
(Friedel-Crafts alkylation aur acylation mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono AlCl₃ istemal karte hain aur electrophilic substitution hain; farq yeh hai.

book_ref.quote: In the Friedel-Crafts acylation reaction, an acyl group is substituted into the benzene ring in the presence of a Lewis acid catalyst.

rows: Alkyl group (R) ring mein lagta hai
Acyl group (R–C=O) ring mein lagta hai

blocks.prompt:
40 Write the equations for Friedel-Crafts methylation of benzene using CH₃Cl and AlCl₃, showing how the electrophile forms.
(CH₃Cl aur AlCl₃ se benzene ki Friedel-Crafts methylation ki equations likhein, electrophile banne ka tareeqa bhi.)
blocks.explanation:
CH₃Cl + AlCl₃ → CH₃⁺ + AlCl₄⁻ (carbocation electrophile)
C₆H₆ + CH₃⁺ → arenium ion → C₆H₅CH₃ + H⁺
H⁺ + AlCl₄⁻ → HCl + AlCl₃ (catalyst wapas)

book_ref.quote: resulting in the formation of a carbocation which acts as an electrophile

blocks.prompt:
41 What is an acyl group? Write the overall equation for acylation of benzene with propanoyl chloride, CH₃CH₂COCl.
(Acyl group kya hai? Propanoyl chloride, CH₃CH₂COCl, se benzene ki acylation ki kul equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Acyl group carbonyl group se juda alkyl group hai, R–C=O.
C₆H₆ + CH₃CH₂COCl → C₆H₅COCH₂CH₃ + HCl (AlCl₃ catalyst); electrophile CH₃CH₂CO⁺ hai.

book_ref.quote: An acyl group is an alkyl group attached to a carbonyl group, R-C=O.

blocks.prompt:
42 Why is AlCl₃ called a catalyst in Friedel-Crafts reactions?
(Friedel-Crafts reactions mein AlCl₃ ko catalyst kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: AlCl₃ halide se chloride le kar electrophile aur AlCl₄⁻ banata hai. Aakhri step mein ring ka proton chloride se mil kar HCl banata hai aur AlCl₃ waisa hi wapas mil jata hai, is liye yeh catalyst hai.

book_ref.quote: This proton attaches itself to a chloride ion, forming HCl. The AlCl₃ catalyst is regenerated.

blocks.prompt:
43 Outline the three steps of the nitration of benzene in words.
(Benzene ki nitration ke teen steps alfaaz mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Conc. HNO₃ aur conc. H₂SO₄ se NO₂⁺ banta hai. (2) Ring ka electron pair NO₂⁺ ko diya jata hai, covalent bond banta hai aur aromaticity khatam. (3) Substituted carbon ka C–H bond toot ta hai; electrons π system mein wapas, aromaticity bahaal.

book_ref.quote: A pair of electrons from the benzene ring is donated to the NO₂⁺ electrophile

blocks.prompt:
44 Write the overall equation for nitration of benzene. Why is H₂SO₄ written over the arrow and not in the equation?
(Benzene ki nitration ki kul equation likhein. H₂SO₄ arrow ke upar kyun likha jata hai, equation mein kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: C₆H₆ + HNO₃ → (conc. H₂SO₄, taqreeban 50 °C) C₆H₅NO₂ + H₂O. Conc. H₂SO₄ NO₂⁺ banane mein madad karta hai magar khatam nahi hota; yeh catalyst hai, is liye equation mein nahi likha jata.

book_ref.quote: Concentrated sulphuric acid acts as a catalyst so is not written in the equations.

blocks.prompt:
45 Give the three steps of the Friedel-Crafts alkylation mechanism.
(Friedel-Crafts alkylation ke mechanism ke teen steps likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) AlCl₃ alkyl halide se react kar ke carbocation (electrophile) banata hai. (2) Ring ke π electrons carbocation par hamla kar ke arenium ion banate hain; aromaticity waqti tor par khatam. (3) Proton nikalne se aromaticity wapas; proton HCl banata hai aur AlCl₃ wapas milta hai.

book_ref.quote: The Friedel-Crafts alkylation reaction proceeds via a three-step mechanism.

blocks.prompt:
46 What is meant by orientation in electrophilic substitution of substituted benzenes?
(Substituted benzenes ki electrophilic substitution mein orientation se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ring par pehle se laga group aage ki electrophilic substitution par asar dalta hai aur tay karta hai ke naya electrophile kis position (ortho, meta ya para) par jaye. Is liye groups meta ya ortho-para directors hain.

book_ref.quote: Any group attached with benzene ring affects the electrophilic substitution reaction

blocks.prompt:
47 Differentiate between meta-directing and ortho-para directing groups.
(Meta-directing aur ortho-para directing groups mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: In ka farq ring par asar aur substitution ki position mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Such groups are mostly electron-withdrawing groups, that destabilize the arenium intermediate.

rows: Ring ko benzene se kam reactive karte hain (deactivating)
Ring ko benzene se ziyada reactive karte hain (activating)
Ring ko electrons de sakte hain
Arenium intermediate ko destabilize karte hain
Ortho aur para products, para ko thori tarjeeh

blocks.prompt:
48 Predict the major product of chlorination of nitrobenzene. Give reason.
(Nitrobenzene ki chlorination ka bara product batayein aur wajah likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1-Chloro-3-nitrobenzene (meta product). –NO₂ electron-withdrawing, deactivating meta director hai, is liye chlorine meta (1,3) par aata hai.
C₆H₅NO₂ + Cl₂ → (FeCl₃) m-ClC₆H₄NO₂ + HCl

book_ref.quote: Nitrobenzene contains a meta directing group (-NO₂), its chlorination occurs at the meta position.

blocks.prompt:
49 What happens when methylbenzene is chlorinated in the presence of AlCl₃ in the dark? Write the balanced equation.
(Andhere mein AlCl₃ ki maujoodgi mein methylbenzene ki chlorination se kya hota hai? Balanced equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Room temperature par ring mein substitution hoti hai; CH₃ 2,4-directing hai, is liye 2-chloromethylbenzene aur 4-chloromethylbenzene ka mixture banta hai.
2C₆H₅CH₃ + 2Cl₂ → 2-ClC₆H₄CH₃ + 4-ClC₆H₄CH₃ + 2HCl

book_ref.quote: Methyl group is 2,4-directing (o-p directing)

blocks.prompt:
50 Why are ortho-para directing groups called activating groups?
(Ortho-para directing groups ko activating groups kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh benzene ring ko electrons de sakte hain, is liye ring electrophiles ke liye benzene se ziyada reactive ho jati hai. Maslan –OH ring ko reactive banata hai aur aane wale groups ko 2, 4 aur 6 par bhejta hai.

book_ref.quote: Note that these are groups that have the ability to donate electrons to the benzene ring.

blocks.prompt:
51 Give the products of bromination of methylbenzene in the presence of aluminium bromide.
(Aluminium bromide ki maujoodgi mein methylbenzene ki bromination ke products batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Bromine se usi tarah ke bromine compounds bante hain: 2-bromomethylbenzene aur 4-bromomethylbenzene (aur HBr), kyun ke methyl group ortho-para (2,4) directing hai.

book_ref.quote: With bromine, you would get the equivalent bromine compounds.

blocks.prompt:
52 Predict the product of further nitration of nitrobenzene. Give reason.
(Nitrobenzene ki mazeed nitration ka product batayein aur wajah likhein.)
blocks.explanation: 1,3-Dinitrobenzene. –NO₂ meta-directing aur deactivating group hai, is liye doosra nitro group meta (1,3) par aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Group that makes the ring less reactive than benzene, and directs the incoming electrophile to attack on meta position only

blocks.prompt:
53 Compare nitrobenzene and methylbenzene in their reactivity towards electrophiles and in the orientation they cause.
(Nitrobenzene aur methylbenzene ka electrophiles ke liye reactivity aur orientation mein muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: –NO₂ meta director hai; –CH₃ (–R group) ortho-para director hai.

book_ref.quote: Substituents direct the reaction to give either the

blocks.prompt:
54 Write the equation for complete combustion of benzene. What is the use of its flame?
(Benzene ki mukammal combustion ki equation likhein. Is ke shole ka kya faida hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2C₆H₆ + 15O₂ → 12CO₂ + 6H₂O. Ziyada hawa mein benzene mukammal oxidize hota hai magar dhuwen wale shole se jalta hai, jo aromatic compounds ka test hai.

book_ref.quote: this reaction gives a smoky flame which is used as a test for aromatic compounds

blocks.prompt:
55 How many moles of O₂ are needed to burn 0.4 mol of benzene completely, and how many moles of CO₂ form?
(0.4 mol benzene ko mukammal jalane ke liye kitne mol O₂ chahiye aur kitne mol CO₂ bante hain?)

book_ref.quote: When benzene is burnt in excess of air, it is completely oxidized to CO₂ and H₂O.

blocks.prompt:
56 What is side-chain oxidation? Name the oxidizing agents used.
(Side-chain oxidation kya hai? Istemal hone wale oxidizing agents ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Benzene ring se seedha jude alkyl group ki oxidation; alkyl group jitna bhi bara ho –COOH ban jata hai aur ring qaim rehti hai. Agents: alkaline KMnO₄, acidic K₂Cr₂O₇ ya dilute HNO₃.

book_ref.quote: In these kinds of reaction, the alkyl groups are oxidized to carboxylic acid group

blocks.prompt:
57 Why does tert-butylbenzene not undergo side-chain oxidation while isopropylbenzene does?
(tert-Butylbenzene side-chain oxidation kyun nahi karta jab ke isopropylbenzene karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Side-chain oxidation ke liye kam az kam aik benzylic hydrogen chahiye. tert-Butylbenzene mein ring se juda carbon tertiary hai aur us par H nahi, is liye reaction nahi. Isopropylbenzene ke benzylic carbon par aik H hai, is liye benzoic acid banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, these reactions have no effect on tertiary carbons attached to an aromatic ring.

blocks.prompt:
58 Give the products of side-chain oxidation of (i) propylbenzene (ii) 1,4-dimethylbenzene.
(Side-chain oxidation ke products likhein: (i) propylbenzene (ii) 1,4-dimethylbenzene.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Benzoic acid, C₆H₅COOH: alkyl group jitna bhi lamba ho, ring par sirf aik –COOH. (ii) Benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid: har methyl par benzylic H hai aur woh –COOH banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Whatever the length of an alkyl group may be

blocks.prompt:
59 Alkanes and benzene both resist oxidation. Why then are alkylbenzenes oxidized?
(Alkanes aur benzene dono oxidation se bachte hain. Phir alkylbenzenes kyun oxidize hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jab alkyl group ring se jud jata hai to benzylic carbon (ring se seedha juda) ziyada reactive aur oxidation ke qabil ho jata hai, is liye side chain –COOH ban jati hai aur ring qaim rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: Both alkane and benzene are very stable and insusceptible to oxidation

blocks.prompt:
60 How can benzene be distinguished from methylbenzene by KMnO₄ solution?
(KMnO₄ solution se benzene aur methylbenzene mein farq kaise karein?)
blocks.explanation: Methylbenzene mein benzylic H hai, oxidize ho kar purple rang khatam karta hai; benzene ke saath rang purple rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Purple colour of KMnO₄ solution is discharged, once consumed in the oxidation reaction.

blocks.prompt:
61 Give the conditions for hydrogenation of benzene and write its equation.
(Benzene ki hydrogenation ki shiraait aur equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: C₆H₆ + 3H₂ → C₆H₁₂ (cyclohexane). Shiraait: bareek nickel catalyst, taqreeban 150 °C (alkenes jaisa), magar ziyada pressure.

book_ref.quote: The reactions are done using the same finely divided nickel catalyst

blocks.prompt:
62 Hydrogenation of benzene is exothermic, yet it needs a higher pressure than alkenes. Explain.
(Benzene ki hydrogenation exothermic hai, phir bhi alkenes se ziyada pressure kyun chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Naye C–H bonds mazboot hain is liye exothermic hai. Magar addition stable delocalised π system ko khatam karta hai, is liye activation barrier ooncha hai; nickel ke saath ziyada pressure lagaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Although the reactions are exothermic overall because of the strength of all the new carbon-hydrogen bonds

blocks.prompt:
63 Differentiate between the reaction of benzene with chlorine in the presence of FeCl₃ and in UV light.
(FeCl₃ ki maujoodgi mein aur UV light mein benzene ke chlorine se reaction mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Shiraait tay karti hain ke substitution hogi ya addition.

book_ref.quote: In the absence of a catalyst, UV light and heat are sufficient for complete halogenation.

header: UV light aur heat mein (catalyst nahi)
rows: Aik Cl aik H ki jagah leta hai
Teen Cl₂ ring par add hote hain

blocks.prompt:
64 Calculate the mass of hydrogen needed to convert 19.5 g of benzene completely to cyclohexane (C₆H₆ = 78 g mol⁻¹, H₂ = 2 g mol⁻¹). Give one use of cyclohexane.
(19.5 g benzene ko mukammal cyclohexane banane ke liye kitni hydrogen chahiye (C₆H₆ = 78 g mol⁻¹, H₂ = 2 g mol⁻¹)? Cyclohexane ka aik istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Moles C₆H₆ = 19.5/78 = 0.25 mol; C₆H₆ + 3H₂ → C₆H₁₂, to H₂ = 0.75 mol = 0.75 × 2 = 1.5 g. Cyclohexane faida-mand solvent aur doosre chemicals ka precursor hai.

book_ref.quote: Cyclohexane is a useful solvent and a precursor in the production of other chemicals.

blocks.prompt:
65 Why do addition reactions destroy the delocalisation of benzene?
(Addition reactions benzene ki delocalisation kyun khatam kar dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Addition mein ring par phaile π electrons naye atoms (maslan hydrogen) se bond banane mein lag jate hain. π system baqi nahi rehta aur ring aromatic stability kho deti hai; isi liye benzene sirf sakht shiraait mein addition karta hai.

book_ref.quote: because those electrons are being used to form bonds with the new hydrogen atoms

blocks.prompt:
66 Write the equation for complete hydrogenation of methylbenzene and name the product.
(Methylbenzene ki mukammal hydrogenation ki equation likhein aur product ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: C₆H₅CH₃ + 3H₂ → (Ni, taqreeban 150 °C, ziyada pressure) C₆H₁₁CH₃, methylcyclohexane. CH₃ wala ring carbon CH ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: involves the addition of 1, 2, or 3 moles of hydrogen to the carbons of benzene
